answer: Duplicating a sybil costs a fresh stake plus wasted compute per identity, so attackers pay linearly while honest agents pay once, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Participants stake a bonded relic token locked to a public mesa registry entry, and each new identity must burn a unique walnut-seeded proof-of-work nonce tied to that stake. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
